abiJson.author: Reza Apes
abiJson.description: Deterministic owner-only NFT vault with same-wallet withdrawal

declarations.name: DeployPersonalVault
declarations.description:
Deploy/activate a deterministic personal vault. It is intentionally a no-op
after authenticating the immutable owner.

declarations.name: WithdrawNftToOwner
declarations.description: Withdraw an NFT only to the vault's immutable original wallet.
